text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
An Umamusume born to a legendary enka 
singer, Kitasan Black. Her dream is to run 
in major races and bring smiles to 
everyone's faces, just like her beloved 
father.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Her rival is Satono Diamond. Back when 
they were young, they made a promise: 
"We'll run the Classic Triple Crown 
together."

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The Umamusume she admires is Tokai Teio. 
Someday, she wants to catch up to her and 
run the best race of her life.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The challenge of the Twinkle Series with 
Kitasan Black begins!
